name: savvy-progress
description: Progress bar above the prompt for /savvy-flow, plus an agents panel (/agents-info) that opens with every session. Fork of johnnyvizz/claude-kit.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, ru or he (Hebrew, drawn right to left)

autoOpen.title: Open the agents panel
autoOpen.description: always: opens with every session and when any subagent starts; savvy: when a savvy-flow worker starts or a plan is reported; any: also when any other subagent starts
